jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.
The opportunity:
Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.
It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.
You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.
About the product:
The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

-
Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

-
Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

-
Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

-
Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

-
Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

-
AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

-
Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

-
Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

-
Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

-
Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

-
Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

-
Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

-
Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

-
Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a frontend-leaning full-stack engineer to build the product experience of ElevenAI, our new voice-first AI assistant for dictation, meetings and everyday work.

ElevenAI started life as a dictation tool our own team uses every day, and it is now launching to the world. It is a small team with a live product, real users and a lot of open ground. The people who join now will decide how it feels, and what it does next.

This is a product role as much as an engineering one. You will own the surfaces people touch every day, from the first-run experience to the moment text lands in the app they are working in. The best version of this work is fast, quiet and trustworthy, and it takes real craft to get there.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Building and polishing the core ElevenAI experience across web, desktop and mobile, including dictation, meeting capture and notes.

- Designing interactions where latency, reliability and feel matter: live transcription, keyboard shortcuts, text insertion into other apps, and permissions people trust.

- Owning features end to end, from a short proposal and prototype through to launch and support in production, reaching into the backend when the feature needs it.

- Turning feedback from early users and colleagues into shipped improvements, quickly.

You might be a product engineer who has shipped a complex interactive tool that people use all day, or a desktop or editor specialist who wants to build something for the whole company to use, and soon the world.

REQUIREMENTS

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and things you have owned.

- Strong frontend engineer, fluent in JavaScript and TypeScript, who has built complex, interactive products with web, desktop or mobile technologies.

- Strong product sense: you can take an ambiguous problem, break it into shippable pieces, and decide what not to build.

- Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, including APIs and streaming connections. Deep backend expertise is not required.

- Evidence of ownership: shipped products, side projects, open source, or product-facing work.

- Thrives in a small, fast-moving team and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding.

Bonus: experience with real-time audio or streaming UIs, native or cross-platform desktop and mobile integrations, or dictation, note-taking and meeting tools.

LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed globally, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+8 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description:
WHY DEPT® ?
We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.
We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.
At DEPT® , you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.
What we believe in
We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:

-
Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.

-
Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.

-
Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.

-
We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.

-
We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.

The role
As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.
You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.
This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.
What you'll do

- Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.

- Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.

- Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.

- Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.

- Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.

- Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.

- Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.

- Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.

- Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.

- Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What you bring

- Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.

- Strong proficiency in Python .

- Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.

- Solid working knowledge of database platforms , both SQL and NoSQL.

- Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.

- Experience with at least one major cloud provider . Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.

- Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.

- A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.

- Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.

- The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.

- A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

- Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.

- Exposure to agent development frameworks.

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.
It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

About Onfleet

Onfleet 's mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web application and dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer based in Latin America or Canada to join one of our cross-functional teams as we build out our Orchestration capabilities. You'll be a core contributor across new feature development, architectural improvements, and system integrations. Your work will span our core platforms, APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces, evolving courier and orchestration functionality, and improving internal tooling and developer experience.

The majority of backend work is in Node.js, with a growing Rust codebase in our newer projects. Front-end work is in React, with a mix of JavaScript and TypeScript. You'll work across a blend of greenfield development and continual, thoughtful development and refinement of existing systems: creating high-quality, well-tested code, contributing to a healthy Scrum cadence, and helping tame legacy complexity by putting code under test, isolating change boundaries, and simplifying tangled implementations.

Everyone on the team owns quality. Automated tests are part of our Definition of Done, and nothing goes to production without being well reviewed by humans and AI agents. If you bring deeper testing or automation experience, that is a real advantage in this seat and we will put it to work, but it is not a prerequisite.

If you have strong Computer Science fundamentals, care deeply about quality and craft, and bring a scrutinizing, questioning mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

How we work

Our engineers combine Computer Science fundamentals with a principled approach to software development that sets a high bar for quality. We're pragmatic, quality-driven, and deliberate about the tools and practices we adopt.

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Success here takes a scrutinizing, questioning mindset: the engineers who thrive are the ones who avoid slop, catch the wrong call before it ships, and drive quality and the right engineering choices forward. Generating code is the easy part; knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. To be successful in this role you will need enough expertise in the languages we use to challenge both the code an agent writes and the architecture it proposes.

We also expect every engineer to be an active contributor to how we work, not just a consumer of existing workflows. Improving our agentic workflows, orchestration, and tooling is a core part of the role; we're always looking for ways to raise the team's quality and efficiency, and that's expected from everyone. Desire and excitement for the application of AI to software development are critical to this role. We are seeking candidates who want to work in and maintain leading-edge agentic workflows, and stay there as the models and tools evolve.

What you'll do

- Build and continually improve your own agentic development workflow, and help raise the team's. This goes far beyond prompting for code: we use AI across the whole path, from PRDs to technical specs, epics, and tickets, into development plans, and finally into high-quality code with thorough unit and integration tests.

- Drive quality through disciplined verification and both agentic and human code review, on your own code and your teammates'. Extend our agentic review tooling as you go, and hold the bar on what gets merged.

- Apply your agentic workflow in both greenfield and legacy code, meeting the different challenges each presents.

- Design and implement high-quality, scalable software in parallel with the tests that validate it.

- Drive and show ownership of features end to end: research/planning, design, implementation, validation, deployment and monitoring in production.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

- Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

- Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

- Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

- Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

- Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

- AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

- Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

- Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

- Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

- Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

- Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

- Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

- Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

- Modelo de contractor, por projeto

- Pagamento em USD por hora

- 100% remoto

- Alocação flexível, conforme a disponibilidade de projetos e o fit

- As oportunidades podem variar em duração, escopo e dedicação semanal, de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes

Algumas oportunidades podem começar imediatamente.
Outras podem ser ativadas conforme novos projetos entrarem no nosso pipeline.
A história por trás desta vaga
Muitas vagas de engenharia de IA ainda giram em torno de experimentos, protótipos isolados ou pesquisa. Esta não é uma delas.
Na Cheesecake Labs , construímos software e soluções com IA para empresas reais, com usuários reais, restrições reais e prazos reais. Nossos squads são pequenos e seniores, e entregam em semanas e meses, não em anos.
Hoje, agentes de IA escrevem a maior parte do nosso código. Esta vaga é para quem decide como as coisas são construídas, direciona os agentes, verifica o resultado e responde por ele diante do cliente.
Estamos buscando uma pessoa Engenheira de Software Sênior: alguém que assume um projeto de cliente desde a primeira conversa de escopo até a produção, e que lida com as decisões de negócio, produto e técnica no caminho. Quando o projeto tem PM, a direção de produto fica com essa pessoa e você é a contraparte técnica dela. Quando não tem, você recebe o problema direto do founder ou do cliente.
Como é esta vaga na prática
Esta não é uma vaga de “receber tickets e implementar features”. Também não é uma vaga de “escrever cada linha na mão”.
Em um projeto típico, você pode:

- Rodar o nosso Spec Driven, nosso fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a specs: reunir contexto, especificar, planejar, implementar por meio de agentes de IA, revisar e fechar o ciclo.

- Transformar um problema de negócio do cliente em um desenho técnico e em uma spec que um agente de IA consiga executar e que você consiga verificar.

- Trabalhar com PM, designer e o squad para entender o que deve ser construído, ou receber os requisitos direto do founder ou do cliente quando não há PM.

- Participar de conversas com o cliente sobre objetivos, escopo e trade-offs técnicos, e mantê-lo atualizado por escrito ao longo do caminho.

- Direcionar agentes de IA (Claude Code, Cursor ou similares) para implementar a partir da sua spec. Escrever código à mão é a exceção, não o padrão.

- Revisar o que os agentes produzem, combinando loops automatizados de revisão com a sua própria checagem de arquitetura e comportamento, e responder por 100% do que é entregue.

- Tomar as decisões de arquitetura. A IA executa, você decide.

- Entregar e iterar, e depois fechar o ciclo devolvendo decisões e edge cases ao contexto do projeto, para que a próxima spec comece mais bem informada.

- Usar todos os dias o nosso harness compartilhado (skills, agentes e loops de revisão), melhorá-lo e devolver o que funciona, para que todos os squads se beneficiem.

- Trabalhar dentro das regras de cada cliente sobre o uso de IA (veja Como usamos IA aqui).

Alguns projetos pesam mais na arquitetura. Outros, nas conversas com o cliente. A maioria mistura os dois. Você trabalha com bastante autonomia, e conta com um Engineering Manager e com o squad quando precisar.
O que costuma funcionar bem por aqui
Quem se destaca nesta vaga costuma:

- Ter construído e entregue produtos de software reais de ponta a ponta, com JS/Typescript, e/ou Python, e conseguir explicar as decisões que tomou.

- Já usar agentes de IA todos os dias para projetar, construir, depurar e pesquisar, e conseguir mostrar o que construiu.

- Pensar em specs: transformar ambiguidade em definições estruturadas e testáveis.

- Ter mentalidade full-stack. Backend, frontend, IA ou produto podem ser o seu forte, e você circula entre as camadas quando o projeto precisa.

- Verificar antes de dizer “pronto” e deixar claro o que foi e o que não foi verificado.

- Trazer problemas cedo, já com opções, e compartilhar o que aprendeu com o time.

- Atuar bem com alta autonomia, pouca burocracia e ciclos rápidos de feedback, em um formato 100% remoto.

Só para ser transparente:

- Você precisa de requisitos detalhados ou de direção constante antes de começar.

- Você vê a IA como ferramenta de apoio, ou prefere escrever a maior parte do código à mão.

- Você se sente confortável entregando resultado de IA que não verificou.

- Você prefere funções focadas só em implementação, sem conversa com cliente ou com o negócio.

- Você não se sente à vontade conversando direto com clientes ou lidando com problemas ambíguos.

- Você tende a ficar em silêncio entre o kickoff e a entrega.

- Você prefere prioridades estáveis a iteração rápida e alta ownership.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

- Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.

- Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.

- Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.

- Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.

- Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.

- Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.

- Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.

- Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

- Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.

- AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.

- Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.

- Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.

- Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
